reasoning_traces.think:
The proposed primitives constitute a layered probabilistic inference system. Calibrated confidence replaces heuristic confidence with a logistic regression-derived probability, resolving the 'two-truths' problem. Beat desk alignment introduces qualitative signals into the scoring pipeline, enhancing interpretability and reducing noise. Prop alignment ensures cross-market consistency by deriving game scripts from player/team props. Context matrix enriches predictions with environmental and event-based variables. Each layer operates in shadow mode initially, then transitions to production under a kill switch. Failure modes include insufficient training data, missing sources, and unresolved flags. Dualities emerge between heuristic and calibrated confidence, and between structured and unstructured inputs. The conjunction gate enforces safety by failing softly, ensuring fewer but more reliable Premium picks.
